Name: Spouse Farmhouse Schedules
Author: Nikanor24
Description:
🏡 Spouse Farmhouse Schedules (WIP)

A comprehensive Stardew Valley mod that enhances [b]spouse behavior inside the farm[/b] with custom schedules, animations, sprite swapping, and real-time in-game editing.



[b]New Features (v1.5.0)

[/b]🔎 Schedule List Filtering[b] 

[/b]The Schedule Editor now includes a [b]filter bar[/b], making it much easier to navigate and find specific schedule entries, especially for players with large or complex routines.

[line]🔄 Added[b] [/b]Compatibility With [i]Wandering Spouses

[/i]This mod now includes support and integration with the [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37773?tab=descriptionhttp://]Wandering Spouses[/url][/b] mod by [b][url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/dandm1/mods?gameId=1303]dandm1[/url][/b].
Huge thanks to [b]dandm1[/b] for the amazing work on Wandering Spouses. It provides all the logic needed to let spouses intelligently explore the farm.

You can now:
[list]
[*]Set a [b]custom schedules[/b] to enable the spouse to wandering, giving the spouse to Wandering Spouses mod control.
[/list][line]🌾 Schedules in New Locations

Schedules are no longer limited to the farmhouse.

You can now assign spouse actions in:
[list]
[*][b]FarmHouse[/b]
[*][b]Cellar[/b]
[*][b]Farm (outdoors)[/b]
[*][b]Greenhouse[/b]
[*][b]Farm Buildings[/b] (Coop, Barn, Shed, Slime Hutch)
[*][b]FarmCave[/b]
[*][b]PIF rooms[/b]
[/list]
[list]
[/list][line]✨ Features

🏠 Smart Spouse Schedules[list]
[*][b]Custom Farmhouse Routines:[/b] Create detailed daily schedules for each spouse.
[*][b]Multiple Schedule Sources:[/b] Supports manual schedules and [b]Content Patcher[/b] integration.
[*][b]Real-Time Execution:[/b] Schedules trigger automatically at specified times.
[*][b]Flexible Movement:[/b] Uses an advanced [b]pathfinding system with fallbacks[/b] to prevent NPCs from getting stuck.
[*][b]Multi-Spouse Compatibility:[/b] Fully supports [b]Polyamory[/b] and multiple spouse rooms.
[/list][line]🎭 Advanced Animation System[list]
[*][b]Custom Animations:[/b] Play any animation from the game’s Data/animationDescriptions. (You  list in Articles)
[*][b]Looping Animations:[/b] Option to make animations loop continuously.
[*][b]Sprite Swapping:[/b] Change NPC sprites dynamically during specific animations or activities.
[*][b]Dialogue Balloons:[/b] Display short dialogue text above the spouse’s head during animations.
[/list][line]👕 Dynamic Sprite Management[list]
[*][b]Farmhouse Outfits:[/b] Automatically switch to pajamas or custom farmhouse sprites when inside.
[*][b]Animation-Specific Sprites:[/b] Use unique sprites for specific animations (e.g., workout, cooking).
[*][b]Automatic Restoration:[/b] Original sprites are restored when the spouse leaves the farmhouse.
[*][b]Multi-Spouse Support:[/b] Works seamlessly even with multiple spouses living together.
[/list][line]🎮 User-Friendly Interface[list]
[*][b]In-Game Schedule Editor:[/b]
Press [b]F2[/b] to open the schedule editor (customizable in settings).Press [b]B[/b] to open the bed assignment editor (customizable in settings).[*][b]Real-Time Editing:[/b] Add, edit, or delete schedules while the game is running.
[*][b]Visual Overview:[/b] Instantly view all schedule entries for each spouse.
[*][b]Bed Assignment Menu:[/b] Manually assign beds for each spouse — great for multi-spouse setups!
[*][b]GMCM Integration:[/b] Configure every setting through [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b].
[/list][line]🧩 Schedule Conditions (When)

You can use the When field to make schedule entries only trigger under specific conditions.
Here are the supported formats:
﻿empty → always true
﻿rain or rain2 → only when it’s raining
﻿spring, summer, fall, winter → by season
﻿mon, tue, wed, thu, fri, sat, sun → by weekday
﻿15 → specific day of the month (e.g., 15th)
﻿spring_15 → specific season + day
﻿spring_mon → season + weekday

You can list multiple conditions separated by commas, e.g.

[code]"spring_mon, rain, 15"[/code]

Only runs if any of them match.


[line]⚙️ How It Works

Schedules are triggered on TimeChanged (every 10 in-game minutes).

If the spouse is [b]inside the farmhouse[/b] at that time, they will:
[list=1]
[*]Pathfind to the target tile.

[*]Face the specified direction.

[*]Optionally play an animation.

[*]Optionally display a dialogue balloon above their head.

[/list]If the spouse leaves the farmhouse (e.g., external schedule or event), their indoor schedule stops automatically.
